Throughout a methodology year the number of overall assessed companies increases and the scores of already assessed companies can be adjusted following a Media and Stakeholder Analysis case (corporate controversy) or reassessments of underlying data. This can result in changes to industry averages, even if the company’s own scores did not change. As part of the Media and Stakeholder Analysis, S&P Global analysts rely on a wide range of news sources, interactions with companies and information provided by RepRisk, a leading provider of ESG risk intelligence.
